name: MessageThread
description: A conversation shown as chat bubbles: other people’s messages at the start with their avatar and name, yours at the end in the accent color, with an optional typing indicator.
whenToUse: For direct messages, support chats and comment conversations.
To show an AI assistant conversation.

whenNotToUse.text: For a timeline of events, not messages.

anatomy.name: Avatar
anatomy.description: Who wrote the messages; once per group.

anatomy.name: Author
anatomy.description: The name above someone else’s group of messages.

anatomy.name: Bubble
anatomy.description: One message; the last in a group has a smaller corner pointing at the author.

anatomy.name: Meta
anatomy.description: Time and delivery status under a message.

anatomy.name: Typing indicator
anatomy.description: Three pulsing dots while someone writes.

values.meaning: Default. Avatars beside other people’s messages.
No avatars, wider bubbles, for narrow side panels.

behavior.text: Consecutive messages from the same person share one avatar and name.
The thread is a log region, so screen readers announce new messages politely.
Long links and words wrap inside the bubble.
Incoming messages sit on the right and outgoing on the left in Arabic.

content: Show times in the reader’s own format, e.g. "9:41" or "Yesterday".
Show delivery status only under your last message.
Name the thread after the other people, e.g. "Conversation with Lana".

guidelines.do: Put the reply box directly under the thread.
guidelines.dont: Separate the composer from the conversation.
guidelines.why: People read the last message and answer right below it.

guidelines.do: Give status only to the latest own message.
guidelines.why: Repeating it adds noise without new information.

guidelines.do: Use compact density in narrow panels.
guidelines.why: Bubbles need the width more than the avatars.

accessibility.role: log, named by label; the typing indicator is a status.

keyboard.action: Moves through links and buttons inside messages.

aria.when: Always; new messages are announced politely.

accessibility.focus: The thread itself takes no focus; interactive content inside messages does.

wcag.how: Authors are named in text, not shown only by side or color.
Bubble text meets AA on both bubble colors in every theme.
New messages and typing are announced without moving focus.

notes: Avatars are decorative because the author name is in the text.

examples.title: Direct message
examples.description: Two people with times and a read status.

examples.title: Typing
examples.description: Shows that the other person is writing.
examples.code:
import { MessageThread } from '@ds/react';

<MessageThread label="Support chat" messages={messages} typing={{ name: 'Support' }} />

examples.title: In a side panel
examples.code:
import { MessageThread } from '@ds/react';

<MessageThread label="Comments" messages={messages} density="compact" />

components.name: MessageThread
components.description:
A conversation as chat bubbles: other people's messages at the start, yours at the end.
Consecutive messages from the same person are grouped under one name and avatar.

label.description: Names the conversation, e.g. "Conversation with Lana".

typing.description: Shows a "… is typing" bubble for this person.

typingLabel.description: Words for the typing bubble. Default "{name} is typing".

density.description: `comfortable` (default) shows avatars and names; `compact` hides avatars for narrow panels.

--message-thread-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--message-thread-message-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--message-thread-bubble-padding-x.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--message-thread-bubble-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--message-thread-bubble-tail-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.

--message-thread-outgoing-bg-color.description: Fill of filled buttons; the accent in light mode, a darker step in dark mode.

--message-thread-outgoing-text-color.description: Text and icons on the matching strong fill (light text in dark mode).

--message-thread-outgoing-border-color.description: Fill of filled buttons; the accent in light mode, a darker step in dark mode.

--message-thread-author-text-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--message-thread-meta-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--message-thread-meta-text-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--message-thread-dot-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.

--message-thread-dot-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--message-thread-dot-duration.description: Elements entering or leaving: modals, drawers, toasts.

--message-thread-dot-easing.description: Moving between two states on screen.
